title: Activating fastProject
author: Mark Edmonds
content:
Request a License Key

As part of activating fastProject, you need to request a license key. When received, please save this license key, as it can be used again if you change computers.

  • Start fastProject/MS Project

Start fastProject/MS Project

  • If fastProject starts on the “Start screen”, double-click Blank project to start a new project

If fastProject starts on the “Start screen”, double-click Blank project to start a new project

  • Click File > fastProject Info (see screen below). If you do not see fastProject Info, follow this link to debug any installation problems: https://lateralworks.com/tools/2025/4/22/debugging-fastproject-installation

Click File > fastProject Info (see screen below). If you do not see fastProject Info, follow this link to debug any installation problems: https://lateralworks.com/tools/2025/4/22/debugging-fastproject-installation

  • Click License Request to generate a unique code

Click License Request to generate a unique code

  • Use the Copy Button to copy and then send the code to contact@lateralworks.com

Use the Copy Button to copy and then send the code to contact@lateralworks.com

Activate fastProject

  • On receipt of your license key, open fastProject

On receipt of your license key, open fastProject

  • Click File > fastProject Info (see screen below)

Click File > fastProject Info (see screen below)

  • Click Activate

Click Activate

  • Enter (or paste) the license key

Enter (or paste) the license key
